failures.failure: The first PowerShell multiline apply_patch argument lost its terminal patch marker.

failures.recovery: Use the same successful apply_patch-tool path; retain both failed invocations.

failures.failure: The first compact inherited-review projection exceeded its output bound.
failures.recovery: Reduce to semantic fields and use bounded recovery windows for omitted rows.

failures.failure: The reduced inherited-review projection still omitted a small middle window.

failures.failure: The first planning builder preflight used collapsed default untracked-directory porcelain and rejected its own owner-scoped files.
failures.recovery: Request --untracked-files=all so every changed path can be checked against the exact owner prefix before generation.

failures.failure: The first planning validator treated the s:/ substring in https:// references and its own scanner definition as Windows drive-path candidates.
failures.recovery: Restrict the private-drive classifier to a drive letter followed by a backslash, then rerun only the failed planning validator dependency.

failures.recovery: Retain and adjudicate the exact validator self-definition as a scanner candidate while preserving the same refusal for every other file.
